source.basis: Operator spec page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
CyrusOne's Allen campus is one of the largest data center sites in Texas that publishes a power figure, at 77 MW of IT capacity across three buildings.

The published numbers are power and floor area, not compute. The campus reports 976,000 square feet of technical space against 77 MW, a ratio that suggests it was not built around the densest racks now used for AI training. Converting megawatts to accelerators requires a rack density the operator does not publish, so any such figure belongs to the reader, not the source.

The certifications cover payment data, health data, federal systems, and audited controls. They qualify the campus for regulated workloads. They do not identify a tenant, and no AI tenant is named.

Within Texas, this is the second largest facility among the 19 that publish a megawatt figure, against a published state total of 475.41 MW. That is a ranking of disclosed capacity only. The state has 137 mapped facilities and most disclose nothing, so the 19-facility set is self-selected and the true ranking is unknown.
